messages:
Marta: Hey team — finalizing the X + LinkedIn push for next Tue launch. Need final assets, CTAs, scheduling windows, and the three short follow-up replies for engagement. Quick checklist below.
Sam G: Got it. ETA on hero GIF and 2 alt captions?
Kevin L: Uploading now — two GIFs (teaser loop + product shot). Links after upload: `gs://redwood-marketing/launch/1719978833/gif_teaser_v1.gif` and `gs://redwood-marketing/launch/1719978833/gif_product_v1.gif`.
Tia R: I can queue scheduling in Buffer/DirectPublish once copy + UTMs are final. Preference: LinkedIn earlier than X.
Marta: Primary CTA = "Get early access"; secondary CTA = "Join our launch webinar". Sam, want to run A/B on narrative (benchmark vs developer-first)?
Sam G: Yes — I'll create two copy variants. Copy A = benchmark narrative (latency/cost metrics), Copy B = developer-first (ease of integration + examples). Also will prep 3 micro-replies for each variant.
Kevin L: Dropping the GIFs in the assets folder now, plus a 1:1 trimmed version for LinkedIn. Also exporting a 1:1 still as fallback.
OpsBot: Scheduling window reserved: Tue 10:00-12:30 PT for promotional posts (automated).
LaunchBot: Checklist reminder: webinar landing page live? tracking pixel installed? HubSpot form mapped to list?
Marta: Landing page is live and pixel installed. HubSpot list created: `launch-webinar-1719`. Form -> list mapping completed.
Tia R: Routing plan: leads go to HubSpot list 'launch-webinar-1719' -> SDR triage tag 'launch_mql' -> nurture drip (3 emails). I'll set the retargeting seed and Slack notify rule.
Sam G: Draft replies for A/B tests:
- A1: "Nice — curious which workload you ran the benchmark on?"
- A2: ":fire: Love the numbers — can you share a brief TL;DR for the thread?"
- A3: "Want a quick demo of the config we used?"

- B1: "How long to get this running end-to-end?"
- B2: "Any SDKs or examples for routing requests?"
- B3: "Is there a hosted option or only private/dedicated?"

Marta: Nice. I'll tweak tone and shorten for X replies, share in 30m.
Kevin L: Confirming final asset names: `gif_teaser_v1.gif`, `gif_product_v1.gif`, `still_fb_v1.png`. Dropped in `gs://redwood-marketing/launch/1719978833/`.
Tia R: Scheduling notes: LinkedIn post queued for Tue 9:00 PT (company page + pulse), X thread queued for 10:00 PT (main post + 3 replies spaced 10m apart). Routing: form -> HubSpot, webhook -> #leads-launch channel.
Marta: One more ask — can we pin the webinar CTA in the first reply for X (so it's visible on mobile)? Sam, Kevin — confirm final copy for pinned reply by EOD. :thumbsup:
Sam G: I'll post final copy in this thread by 4pm.
Kevin L: All assets uploaded and versions noted in the folder README.
Tia R: All set from scheduling side, queued and awaiting final copy. I'll remove schedule hold after final sign-off.
Marta: Thanks team — if no blockers I'll give sign-off at 5pm and proceed with the push.
Tia R: Roger — scheduling will go live once you hit approve. Ping if you want retargeting tweaks after the first hour.
